summary: Russia launched a massive aerial assault involving 74 missiles and 284 UAVs targeting various Ukrainian regions. Significant strikes were reported in Volgograd, targeting Wildberries warehouses and energy infrastructure. Multiple civilian casualties and infrastructure damage were reported across several fronts including Dnepropetrovsk and Zaporozhye.
key_points: Russia launched a massive air attack involving 74 missiles and 284 UAVs during the night (Source: @UkraineNow/83042).
A Russian Kh-101 cruise missile entered Polish airspace (Source: @UkraineNow/83042).
Russian strikes hit a Wildberries warehouse and a power engineering enterprise in Volgograd, resulting in five civilian casualties (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
The Russian military struck a fuel pumping station and a fuel distribution node in Novye Belyary, Odesa region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
Russian forces reportedly took control of the villages of Mogritsa and Malaya Sloboda in the Sumy region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
Russian forces reportedly took control of the village of Yurchenkovo in the Kharkov region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
Russian forces reportedly took control of the villages of Krasnoyarsk and Dobropolyia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
Units of the 'East' GRU reportedly occupied strongholds in the Zorevka and Zelenyi areas in the Dnepropetrovsk region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a large-scale aerial campaign using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs targeting multiple Ukrainian regions. Significant strikes were recorded against energy infrastructure and logistics hubs, including Wildberries warehouses in Volgograd. The conflict continues with territorial shifts reported in Sumy, Kharkov, and Dnepropetrovsk regions.

points: In the Dnepropetrovsk region, an attack on a shopping center in Pavlohrad resulted in eight people injured, with two in serious condition (Source: @UkraineNow/83062).
In the Sumy region, the enemy dropped four KABs on an industrial zone on the outskirts, causing large fires and significant damage (Source: @UkraineNow/83050).
In the Odesa region, a fuel pumping station and a fuel distribution node in Novye Belyary were hit (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Kherson region, attacks resulted in 5 civilians killed and 9 injured over a 24-hour period (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Zaporozhye region, a drone attack on a house in Vinogradnoe caused a fire and one injury (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Khmelnitsky region, an explosion and subsequent detonation occurred at a military unit (Source: @UkraineNow/83061).
A Wildberries warehouse and a power engineering enterprise were attacked in Volgograd (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
A fire occurred at the 'Nizhnekamskneftekhim' facility in Tatarstan, which was subsequently localized (Source: @tass_agency/388119).
A Wildberries warehouse in Zelenodolsk, Tatarstan, was targeted (Source: @UkraineNow/83043).
In the Rostov region, UAVs were shot down in Taganrog, Bataysk, Rodionovo-Nesvetaysky, and Myasnikovsky districts (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In Gukovo, a UAV attack destroyed interfloor slabs of a building, injuring a woman (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Belgorod region, a woman was injured by shrapnel from an FPV drone in Oktyabrsky (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
Russian forces reportedly took control of the village of Yurchenkovo in the Kharkov region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In Krasny Lyman, the Russian Army continues to advance in the assault on the city (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
Enemy forces are reportedly counterattacking near Redkodum in several areas north of Krasny Lyman (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the DPR, a man was killed in an attack on a passenger car in Gorlovka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
Russian forces reportedly took control of the villages of Mogritsa and Malaya Sloboda in the Sumy region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Belgorod region, a drone struck a car parked at an enterprise in Shebekino, injuring a woman (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Zaporozhye region, a massive artillery strike by Ukrainian Armed Forces in Blagoveshchenka killed a local resident (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Zaporozhye region, a drone attack in the Kuibyshev district near Smirnovo killed one civilian and hospitalized another (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Kherson region, attacks targeted civilian villages and the Skadovsk-Kalanchak highway (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
In the Luhansk region, a UAV attacked a civilian truck on the road to Alchevsk, killing the driver (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
Russia utilized 74 missiles and 284 UAVs in a night attack (Source: @UkraineNow/83042).
A Russian Kh-101 cruise missile entered Polish territory (Source: @UkraineNow/83042).
UAVs were shot down over Crimea and Sevastopol (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32060).
A reactive UAV was reported heading towards Zhulyany (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69587).
A reactive UAV was reported heading towards Vyshneve (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69587).

sections.threat_assessment: The scale of the Russian aerial campaign, involving hundreds of UAVs and dozens of missiles, indicates a high-intensity effort to degrade Ukrainian infrastructure and air defenses. The targeting of logistics hubs like Wildberries and energy facilities suggests a strategy of domestic destabilization and economic pressure. The reported territorial gains by GRU units in Sumy and Kharkov indicate continued pressure on multiple fronts.
sections.regional_response: The incident involving a Kh-101 missile entering Poland highlights increasing friction and security risks for NATO members bordering Ukraine. In the US, political tension is noted regarding President Trump's stance on transferring Patriot interceptors to Ukraine. Domestic responses in Russia include logistical restructuring by companies like Wildberries to mitigate the impact of attacks on their supply chains.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of 'eactive' UAVs and large-scale missile strikes suggests a coordinated multi-domain assault. The reported occupation of specific villages by GRU units indicates tactical shifts in the Sumy and Kharkov sectors. The targeting of civilian infrastructure in Zaporozhye and Kherson continues to result in significant non-combatant casualties.
